items.descZh: suta是为解决AI生成UI时反复出现的同质化卡片、色彩泛滥和过度装饰等"AI slop"问题而生的设计系统。它提供了一套完整的布局、颜色和动效指南，并附带56个UI模式的可复用代码，直接集成到Claude Code和Codex工作流中。在相同模型和请求条件下，启用suta后生成的界面在视觉一致性和专业度上明显优于未启用状态，尽管生成耗时有所增加，但结果更接近人工设计水准。该工具适合依赖AI编码助手生成产品界面的开发者和设计团队，也可作为独立skill在其他agent中安装使用。
items.quote: 我开发了 suta，因为 AI 生成的 UI 总是重复同样的卡片、颜色过多以及不必要的装饰。

items.title: Show HN: Another App Store Screenshot Creator, but with high quality images
items.desc: Why is it so hard to create simple, but beautiful app store screenshots? I tried several tools and they either want money or the image resolution export is crap. Unbelievable! That's why I build screenbuilder.app. Easy and completely free to create images for your store without any size editing
items.author: bert2002
items.descZh:
# 产品分析摘要

## 背景分析
用户在为应用商店设计截图时常面临工具收费、导出分辨率低、需要手动调整尺寸等痛点。针对这些问题，screenbuilder.app 应运而生，旨在提供一个简单、免费且高效的解决方案。

## 核心功能
该工具的核心功能是帮助用户轻松创建应用商店的展示图片。它通过自动化处理尺寸和格式问题，省去了繁琐的编辑步骤，让用户能专注于截图内容本身的设计。

## 产品亮点
* **完全免费**：无需任何付费即可使用全部功能。
* **操作简便**：无需手动调整尺寸，工具会自动适配不同商店的要求。
* **高分辨率导出**：确保输出的图片质量满足应用商店的高标准。

## 适用场景
这款工具非常适合独立开发者、小型创业团队以及需要频繁更新应用商店素材的运营人员，能显著提升工作效率并降低设计成本。

items.descZh: SynoRing R1 是一款专为 AR 和智能眼镜设计的手势控制戒指，旨在通过自然的手势交互减少操作中断，提升沉浸式体验的流畅度。其核心功能允许用户通过点击选择、滑动滚动、圈选调整和长按应用等手势，控制 AR 眼镜、手机、电脑或机器人等多种设备。产品的亮点包括采用氧化锆陶瓷和不锈钢材质，宽度仅 8 毫米，集成六个触点与柔性电路以实现精准手势识别；预购价 99 美元（原价 129 美元），预计 2027 年第一季度发货，美国境内免运费。适用场景涵盖空间应用中的音乐、阅读和导航等，特别适合需要免提控制的日常使用，帮助用户保持专注，避免触碰屏幕或发出语音命令。

[](/peters/localci/blob/main/LICENSE) [](/peters/localci/blob/main/docs/assets/demo.gif) Waiting for GitHub to pick up your push, queue a runner and rebuild everything from a cold cache is slow. Sometimes GitHub is just down. localci runs your existing .github/workflows/ci.yml on your own machine, in seconds, with your build cache still warm. No new config. It reads the workflows you already have. Your OS, your jobs. It runs the jobs whose runson matches your machine (Linux, macOS or Windows) and tells you which ones need another OS. Real steps. Shell steps, matrices, needs, outputs, GITHUB_ENV, if: conditions and services: (as Docker containers) behave like they do on GitHub. Setup actions such as actions/checkout are skipped, because your machine already has the checkout and the tools. Made for agents. One command teaches Claude Code, Codex and other agents to run the right subset of your CI before they push. Tiny. One static binary, under 800 KB to download, installed in under 2 seconds. The numbers Measured on [Horizon](https://github.com/peters/horizon), a public Rust workspace with a Linux, macOS and Windows CI matrix, on 10 and 11 October 2026. Waiting for GitHub vs. checking locally Time One GitHub CI run, push to result (median of 18 runs) 27 minutes Same Linux jobs with localci run, one after another 15 to 23 minutes Same change with localci run fast 2 minutes 16 seconds localci run fast again, nothing changed 0 seconds A failing CI test, found by localci run repochecks before any push 4 seconds One code review round with Copilot on the PR, plus a push about 5 minutes One local review round (the skill's Copilot CLI prompt), no push 1 to 4 minutes What it saves on a pull request. Without localci, every push starts a full CI run of about 62 runnerminutes, and a fix round waits for it. In the last 40 merged Horizon PRs: Review rounds CI runs Runner time Small PRs (5 files or fewer), median 1 1 63 min Large PRs (more than 10 files), median 5 5 307 min Large PR with localci and the skill's PR loop (estimate) 1 to 2 1 to 2 60 to 125 min With the PR loop, you review and test locally until both are clean, and the review on GitHub becomes a final check instead of the place where you iterate. For a large PR that is about 1½ hours less waiting and 3 to 4 hours less runner time. The largePR row is an estimate; the rows below are measured. Real PRs, as the loop improved PR What was new Review rounds on GitHub CI runs Open to ready [1461](https://github.com/peters/horizon/pull/1461) localci before each push, fixes pushed without a CI run 4 (1 with findings) 2 for 4 pushes first approval after 9 min [1466](https://github.com/peters/horizon/pull/1466) a general local review before the PR 5 4 started for 5 pushes 42 min [1471](https://github.com/peters/horizon/pull/1471) a local review that asks for concrete failing inputs, and GitHub's review as the final check 1 1 12 min For comparison, the median small Horizon PR before localci took 24 minutes from opening to merge, with one review round and one CI run of 63 runnerminutes. items.author: petersunde
items.descZh: 针对 GitHub Actions CI 排队慢、冷缓存及服务不稳定等痛点，localci 允许开发者在本地机器上秒级运行现有的 `.github/workflows/ci.yml` 工作流，无需任何额外配置。它能智能匹配本机操作系统对应的作业分支，完整支持 Shell 步骤、矩阵、环境变量及 Docker 容器服务，并自动跳过冗余的代码拉取步骤。其亮点在于极致的轻量与高效，静态二进制文件不足 800 KB，安装仅需不到 2 秒；实测将原本中位耗时 27 分钟的 CI 任务本地运行缩短至 2 分 16 秒，无变更时执行时间为 0 秒，推送前捕获失败测试仅需 4 秒。该工具专为 AI 编程代理（如 Claude Code 和 Codex）打造，可通过单条命令在推送前自动运行关键 CI 测试，极大缩短大 PR 的审查周期。它非常适合需要高频迭代、追求零延迟推送的开发团队，结合本地 PR 循环可为大型 PR 节省约 1.5 小时等待与 3 至 4 小时的 Runner 时长。
items.quote: localci 让你能在自己的机器上秒级运行 .github/workflows/ci.yml，而且构建缓存还是预热好的。

items.descZh: 在现代快节奏的工作与生活中，任务堆积和多任务并行常导致效率低下与身心倦怠。GSD Task Manager 正是为应对这一痛点而生，旨在帮助用户从混乱的待办事项中脱身，聚焦于真正重要的任务。其核心功能是提供一种简单直观的可视化界面，将待办事项清晰区分为“紧急”与“重要”四象限，让用户能够优先处理高价值事务，避免无效忙碌。亮点在于完全离线运行，无需网络即可使用，保障了数据隐私与使用的连续性，同时界面设计极简，降低认知负荷。虽然未提供具体性能数值，但其离线能力与视觉化分类可显著提升任务完成率，适用于需要自主管理个人项目的学生、自由职业者或追求高效办公的专业人士。

items.descZh: Perigee 是一款基于 WebGL 2 的免费开源 3D 实时可视化应用，通过浏览器即可动态呈现地球、月球及火星轨道上的人造物体，以及正在穿越太阳系的深空探测器。其核心功能是利用公开数据源 CelesTrak、NASA/JPL Horizons 和 Astronomy Engine，在用户本地浏览器中实时计算并渲染所有航天器的三维位置，无需服务器中转。该工具的亮点在于其数据权威性与渲染流畅度的结合，能够以零延迟的交互体验展示近地卫星的密集分布和行星际探测器的漫长轨迹，为用户提供沉浸式的太空态势感知。它非常适合天文爱好者、航天领域学生和教育工作者用于直观理解轨道力学和全球航天活动格局。

items.desc: description: Your Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, OpenClaw and Hermes agents as little guys in your Mac menu bar. See who&x27;s working, who has news and who needs you. title: littleguys image: https://littleguys.hervalicio.us/opengraphimage.jpg?opengraphimage.2q_4w406n58h4.jpg One look tells you everything. The guy in your menu bar acts out what your agents are doing. No dashboards, no tabhunting. Everyone, at a glance. Click the guy for every agent on every machine, with a live status ring, the last message and a quick reply. Approve in one click. Commands that need you show up as cards: allow once, always allow or deny. No more “\[y/N\]” buried in terminal tab 9. Routines that just run. Morning digests, nightly dependency bumps, weekly numbers. Friendly schedules, runnow, and results that land in a thread. From any machine. Guys on your Mac mini, your homelab and your laptop, all in one place. Finds gateways on your tailnet and LAN by itself. Bring any guy. Claude CodeCodexGemini CLIGooseOpenCodeOpenClawgatewayHermesagentany ACP agent littleguys speaks the Agent Client Protocol, so new agents are one click away from the ACP registry. It's a friendly face for the agents you already run, not a new place to run them. Free. Open source. Yours. littleguys holds your gateway tokens and approves real commands on your machines. You should be able to read every line of it, so you can. [Read the code](https://github.com/herval/littleguys) 🔒 Talks straight to your agents. No littleguys account, no cloud. 📭 No analytics, no telemetry. 🦀 Rust core + React, built on Tauri. Install it. There's no download yet, so littleguys builds from source. Paste this into Terminal on any Mac running macOS 13 or later: curl fsSL https://littleguys.hervalicio.us/install.sh bash Copy It installs anything missing (the Xcode Command Line Tools, Rust, Node, pnpm) without sudo or touching your shell profile, then builds littleguys.app into /Applications. The first build takes a few minutes; then look for the guy in your menu bar. Run it again to update. Everything it fetches lives in ~/.littleguys, and you can read [install.sh](https://github.com/herval/littleguys/blob/main/install.sh) before you run it.
items.author: herval
items.descZh: littleguys 是一款将 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini 等多种 AI 代理以拟人化“小人”形式集成到 macOS 菜单栏的创新工具，旨在通过直观的视觉动画取代传统的仪表盘和繁杂的标签页切换。用户只需点击菜单栏即可实时查看各代理的状态环、最新消息并进行快速回复，而需要审批的命令会以卡片形式弹出，提供“允许一次”、“始终允许”或“拒绝”选项，彻底告别隐藏在终端深层标签页中的 `[y/N]` 确认提示。该工具采用 Rust 核心结合 React 和 Tauri 构建，完全开源、无账号无云端，并彻底摒弃了分析与遥测，通过自动发现 tailnet 和局域网网关，实现跨 Mac mini、笔记本等多设备的一屏统管。它原生支持晨间摘要、夜间依赖更新等自动化例行任务，并兼容 ACP 协议，使新代理的添加仅需点击即可完成。安装过程极其简便，通过一行终端命令即可在无需 sudo 权限的情况下静默编译部署，所有网关令牌与数据完全本地化存储，确保用户对机器指令拥有绝对掌控权。
items.quote: 它为你已经运行的智能体提供了一个友好的界面，而不是一个运行它们的新地方。
